name: Load balancer
simple: A traffic warden. Lots of computers could answer, so it picks one that isn’t busy, and sends every parcel of your video to that same one.
technical: An L4 load balancer holds the service address (VIP). It hashes each connection’s 5-tuple onto a healthy backend (consistent hashing), so every packet of one TCP connection reaches the same server; health checks take broken servers out.

2010.technical: A hardware load balancer (an appliance such as F5’s BIG-IP, or a card in the aggregation switch) holds the service address (VIP). It keeps a table of connections and sends every packet of one TCP connection to the same healthy server; health checks take broken servers out.
